title: Lanao del Sur to hold town halls for families of Marawi siege victims

blocks.text: MARAWI CITY — The provincial government of Lanao del Sur is gearing up to hold town hall meetings in three Mindanao cities to help families of victims who went missing during the 2017 Marawi siege obtain information and assistance in identifying their loved ones. The preparations were discussed during the 10th meeting of the Technical Working Group (TWG) on the Action Plan for Marawi Siege Victims Identification on Oct. 29 at the New Capitol Complex in Marawi City. The planned town hall sessions will be held in Marawi, Iligan and Pagadian cities, with the participation of concerned local government units and […]...
